title: Binary Tree Right Side View
statement:
Given the `root` of a binary tree, imagine yourself standing on the right side of it. Return the values of the nodes you can see, ordered from top to bottom.

Build a real `TreeNode` tree from `values`, then BFS level by level, taking the last node visited at each level (the rightmost visible node).
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100]

editorial.approach: BFS level by level (as in Level Order Traversal). At each level, after collecting the level's nodes in order, take the value of the last node in that level — that is the rightmost node visible from the side. Collect one such value per level.
